title: Startup session scan off the stopped-session count (#4377)
intent: Claiming Issue #4377 (startup session scan). Root cause verified in code: three sync full-directory parses at startup — LaunchWizardMemoryCache::load in AppRuntime::new, enumerate_worktrees (session_ids has no consumer) in bootstrap, and load_recovery_sessions (lock+parse+2x serialize per file). runtime-state reset is cheap; the Issue's guess there was wrong. Plan: restrict sync parse to restore candidates (placeholder-backed + mtime within the 24h freshness window), defer the Interrupted sweep for the rest to the blocking worker, load the wizard cache off-thread with join-on-first-use, drop the unused session_ids inventory parse, and add a session_load phase with count to perf.startup. This branch merges origin/work/issue-3808 (PR #4379) because perf.startup and measure-startup.mjs live there; the PR will state that dependency.
